description: Source code implementing mesh data structures and operations for tessellation, including creation, deletion, splicing, connecting, and merging mesh elements such as vertices, edges, and faces.

classes.name: EdgePair
classes.description: Struct holding a pair of half-edges for efficient allocation and deallocation.

methods.name: MakeEdge
methods.description: Creates a new pair of half-edges forming a loop, with no vertices or faces assigned yet.

methods.name: Splice
methods.description: Modifies the mesh connectivity by exchanging the Onext pointers of two half-edges.

methods.name: MakeVertex
methods.description: Attaches a new vertex to a half-edge and updates the vertex loop.

methods.name: MakeFace
methods.description: Creates a new face and attaches it to a loop of half-edges.

methods.name: KillEdge
methods.description: Removes an edge (pair of half-edges) from the mesh.

methods.name: KillVertex
methods.description: Removes a vertex from the mesh, updating affected edges.

methods.name: KillFace
methods.description: Removes a face from the mesh, updating affected edges.

methods.name: tessMeshMakeEdge
methods.description: Creates a new edge, vertices, and face, initializing the mesh structure.

methods.name: tessMeshSplice
methods.description: Changes mesh topology by splicing two half-edges.

methods.name: tessMeshDelete
methods.description: Deletes an edge and updates the mesh accordingly.

methods.name: tessMeshAddEdgeVertex
methods.description: Adds a new edge with a new vertex from an existing edge.

methods.name: tessMeshSplitEdge
methods.description: Splits an existing edge into two, inserting a new vertex.

methods.name: tessMeshConnect
methods.description: Creates a new edge connecting two half-edges, possibly splitting or merging loops.

methods.name: tessMeshZapFace
methods.description: Removes a face and associated edges from the mesh.

methods.name: tessMeshNewMesh
methods.description: Initializes a new empty mesh structure.

methods.name: tessMeshUnion
methods.description: Merges two meshes into one, destroying the second.

methods.name: tessMeshMergeConvexFaces
methods.description: Attempts to merge adjacent convex faces within a maximum vertex count.

methods.name: tessMeshDeleteMesh
methods.description: Frees all storage associated with a mesh.

methods.name: tessMeshCheckMesh
methods.description: Performs self-consistency checks on the mesh structure.
